data.title: Uber's Secure AI Framework Governs Autonomous AI Agents Across Their Lifecycle
data.description: In a recent article, Uber Engineering highlights the limitations of traditional identity and API controls in securing AI agents that dynamically reason over external content and take real-world actions. Uber developed a framework to determine whether an agent's action is appropriate given the user's request, the agent's intended purpose, its permissions, and the context of the interaction.
